maya: weird bug in sampleapp rerank: embeddings batcher produced mixed-dim vectors after retry
kevin: mixed how?
maya: some items 1024, others 1536. repro shows same request id but retry path merged responses
sam: any code?
maya: yes, helper was concatenating partials when merging:
```
return base.map((b,i)=> b.concat(partial[i]));
```
kevin: oof. should replace not concat, and validate dims
alex: also noticed retry headers differed (x-request-id vs x-batch-id) so smart-routing sent fallback model for retry
kevin: fixes: throw on dim mismatch, ensure idempotency headers stable, add parity test across node/python helpers
maya: opened PR to stop concat and add dim check: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/789
ci-bot: pipeline queued -> devex/embedding-batcher-parity-check
sam: I'll add e2e that injects mismatched partials and assert client errors
kevin: add changelog note and onboarding doc clarifying `embedding` vs `embeddings` response key
maya: assigning sam for tests, maya for hotfix/docs, alex for changelog. ETA EOD tomorrow
kevin: thanks :thumbsup:
